description: Existing-work sources for BioSignalAgent task/tool wrappers.

entries.next_wrapper: Keep Pan-Tompkins as default, add detector comparison and annotation-tolerance evaluator.

existing_work: Long-segment backend uses mixed Apnea-ECG+UCDDB+SLPDB sequence-context CNN-BiLSTM to avoid Apnea-ECG-only overclaiming.
Short 60-second backend now uses a mixed Apnea-ECG+UCDDB+SLPDB RR/EDR CNN-BiLSTM instead of the Apnea-ECG-only model.
Mixed short-window grouped CV: F1 0.522, AUROC 0.716 overall; source F1 0.606 on Apnea-ECG, 0.484 on UCDDB, 0.509 on SLPDB.
Mixed long-window grouped CV: F1 0.551, AUROC 0.748 overall; source F1 0.706 on Apnea-ECG, 0.484 on UCDDB, 0.521 on SLPDB.
entries.next_wrapper: Improve cross-dataset ECG apnea with better R-peak quality filtering, per-source calibration, and multimodal RESP/SpO2 fusion for report-level apnea.

existing_work: Default rhythm-segment backend uses MIT-BIH rhythm windows plus partial MIT-BIH AFDB rhythm windows with record-group CV.
ECG_detect_afib now uses a separate binary AF feature classifier trained on MITDB+partial AFDB, decoupled from multiclass rhythm classification.
Binary AF grouped CV: F1 0.728, recall 0.840, precision 0.642, AUROC 0.974 on 3431 windows.
Small 240-window MITDB smoke benchmark: AF F1 0.962; treat as in-domain smoke, not final SOTA.
Adding more AFDB normal-heavy records without careful validation hurt F1, so the default keeps the stronger partial binary AF model.
entries.next_wrapper: Finish full AFDB/CinC2017 acquisition and train/evaluate raw ECG CNN/CRNN AF models against the binary feature backend.
Beat-level wrapper now exposes per-beat abnormal probabilities, RR-pattern proxy labels, and subtype summaries; next step is formal MIT-BIH/SVDB/INCART beat-level external validation.

existing_work: Record-heldout EDB ST episode scoring script
PTB-XL lead-II ResNet experiment below feature baseline
PTB-XL 12-lead ResNet experiment below feature baseline
PTB-XL 707-record STTC feature classifier selected for default
entries.next_wrapper: ST/ischemia default uses the broader EDB 12-record classifier (record-heldout window F1 0.590, AUROC 0.860; OOF episode F1 0.673, recall 0.787). PTB-XL defaults are target-specific: 329-record CD/conduction feature classifier (F1 0.730, AUROC 0.836) and 707-record STTC/ST-T feature classifier (F1 0.765, AUROC 0.883). Lead-II and 12-lead ResNet experiments were worse on the small subset. Next step is full PTB-XL 12-lead deep training; QT delineation still needs stronger LUDB/full-QTDB validation.

existing_work: stress and fatigue screening from RR variability
entries.next_wrapper: Implemented HRV feature and nonspecific stress/fatigue proxy wrapper; next step is dataset-specific calibration because stress/fatigue labels are context-dependent.

existing_work: CapnoBase direct-label shallow 1D U-Net peak model integrated as conservative fallback/diagnostic candidate; multiscale detector remains default cross-dataset path.
entries.next_wrapper: Added HR, PRV, and fiducial-point wrappers; next step is benchmark-specific fiducial validation for onset/notch labels.

existing_work: CapnoBase direct-label shallow 1D U-Net peak model integrated as conservative fallback/diagnostic candidate; multiscale detector remains default cross-dataset path.
entries.next_wrapper: MIMIC PERform AF benchmark added; next expand records and compare against ECG-referenced AF labels with artifact filtering.
Split PPG respiration into AM/FM/BW feature extractors and benchmark against RESP.

candidate_datasets: MIMIC waveform dual-wavelength subsets when available
entries.next_wrapper: Implemented calibration-gated red/IR ratio-of-ratios proxy; real SpO2 requires dual-wavelength signals and device calibration.

entries.task: BP, vascular, stress, sleep, exercise, and shock proxies
existing_work: PPG morphology and arterial stiffness proxies
wearable HR/PRV sleep and stress features
entries.next_wrapper: Implemented practical proxy wrappers with calibration disclaimers; next benchmark work should separate calibrated BP, sleep staging, and stress datasets.

entries.task: Pulse arrival/transit timing and BP proxy
existing_work: Pulse arrival time (PAT) from ECG R-peak to PPG systolic foot/peak
Pulse transit time/PAT cuffless BP literature
entries.next_wrapper: Replace peak-to-peak PAT with foot/onset PAT when robust PPG foot labels are available; calibrate against ABP/cuff before BP claims.

existing_work: Inhale/exhale extrema detection with per-event position and amplitude outputs
Respiratory rate from airflow/impedance peak detection
entries.next_wrapper: Use event intervals from RESP_summarize_event_burden for proper event-level scoring against UCDDB/SHHS/MESA annotations; current ML report remains window-level.
Evaluate multimodal report against event-level PSG annotations; current fusion is weighted screening evidence.

entries.task: Desaturation, hypoxemia burden, ODI/oximetry sleep-apnea screening, and SpO2-only respiratory-event ML
entries.next_wrapper: Implemented rolling-baseline ODI3/ODI4, hypoxic burden features, oximetry proxy risk, and UCDDB SpO2-only ML model. Next: full-night AHI/ODI severity on SHHS/MESA or event-level lag-aware labels.

existing_work: UCDDB single-channel EEG feature-ensemble coarse staging baseline
entries.next_wrapper: Implemented UCDDB single-channel EEG coarse sleep-stage ML tool: accuracy 0.741/macro-F1 0.731/macro-AUROC 0.897 on one-record window CV. Next: Sleep-EDF/YASA or U-Sleep-style subject-independent benchmark before claiming clinical sleep staging.

existing_work: CHB-MIT single-channel EEG seizure feature ensemble baseline
entries.next_wrapper: Implemented small CHB-MIT chb01 seizure ML screen: 114 windows, 3 EDF-file grouped CV, AUROC 0.959/macro-F1 0.923. Next: complete CHB-MIT multi-subject download and full event-level evaluation before any SOTA claim.
Add MNE-based channel-aware artifact features once multi-channel EEG manifests are available.

existing_work: Added segmentation-aware PCG features: systolic/diastolic high-frequency ratios, continuity, murmur timing pattern, state coverage, cycle CV, and quality flags.

Springer-sounds supervised TCN segmentation baseline integrated: val fold0 S1 micro-F1 0.974, S2 micro-F1 0.952, HR MAE 0.949 bpm after event postprocessing; full proxy baseline across 792 records was S1 micro-F1 0.705, S2 micro-F1 0.645, HR MAE 4.62 bpm.
entries.next_wrapper: Run multi-fold Springer validation and package the TCN as the default PCG segmentation backend; S3/S4 still needs a labeled extra-heart-sound benchmark.

existing_work: CirCor-style patient multi-location log-frequency attention CNN integrated as research screening model
Added segmentation-aware PCG features: systolic/diastolic high-frequency ratios, continuity, murmur timing pattern, state coverage, cycle CV, and quality flags.
Added explicit proxy wrappers for HR, rhythm irregularity, S3/S4 candidates, valve-pattern screening, congenital/structural abnormality screening, and longitudinal heart-function feature monitoring.

BMD-HS valve subtype recording-level feature classifier integrated into PCG_screen_valve_disease_proxy with patient-grouped CV: AS AUROC 0.788/F1 0.650, AR AUROC 0.656/F1 0.599, MR AUROC 0.563/F1 0.534, MS AUROC 0.624/F1 0.546, N AUROC 0.795/F1 0.510.

BMD-HS valve spectrogram CNN 5-fold ensemble integrated as the preferred valve subtype backend: patient-heldout macro-F1 mean 0.638 +/- 0.018 and macro-AUROC mean 0.754 across folds; best fold macro-F1 0.660/macro-AUROC 0.785. Feature baseline remains fallback.

CirCor outcome/structural-abnormality backends added for PCG_screen_congenital_abnormality_proxy: logistic feature model selected by patient-level AUROC (AUROC 0.666, F1 0.722, recall 0.817, specificity 0.346 at threshold 0.5) plus a patient multi-location CNN sanity model (AUROC 0.582, F1 0.573); both are research screening signals, not CHD diagnosis.
entries.next_wrapper: CHD/S3/S4 still need stronger labeled benchmarks; current CirCor outcome backends are modest and should remain low-to-moderate confidence screening evidence.

entries.next_wrapper: Add PSG-labeled MESA/SHHS actigraphy training when authorized NSRR data are available; current sleep/wake remains calibrated proxy.

Feature ensembles and 1D CNN/RNN fall classifiers
entries.next_wrapper: Add SisFall/UP-Fall external validation and placement-aware calibration; current UniMiB model is simulated smartphone-pocket only.
Implemented WESAD-compatible tonic/phasic/SCR feature extractor; next higher-fidelity option is optional NeuroKit2/cvxEDA when dependency policy allows.

Implemented WESAD EDA-only stress ML tool and WESAD protocol-state classifier. Current subject-grouped CV: binary feature ensemble AUROC 0.870/BAcc 0.780; three-class raw CNN macro-AUROC 0.759/macro-F1 0.568. Next: external affect datasets such as DEAP/AMIGOS for generic arousal/valence and multimodal WESAD fusion when task permits.
Add onset detector variants and gesture/fatigue labels before model training.
Add protocol-aware fatigue benchmark rather than tuning current single-window proxy.

entries.task: ABP fiducial detection, pulse/hemodynamics, and pressure-event screening
existing_work: ABP fiducial-point detection: systolic onset, systolic peak, dicrotic notch, diastolic peak, and diastolic phase endpoint.
candidate_datasets: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset ABP channels
entries.next_wrapper: Challenge 2009 smoke now has heuristic Event1 8/10, Event2 30/40, and logistic ranker Event2 32/40 but Event1 6/10; next step is full-window local A/B download plus larger learned forecasting model.

Tool-routing and input triage before task-specific biosignal analysis
entries.next_wrapper: Expand training examples per modality, add image-to-signal extraction outputs as inputs, and evaluate routing accuracy under missing or noisy metadata.

Computer-vision based waveform extraction from scanned plots

ECG-Image-Kit style rendered waveform image benchmarks

existing_work: Signal-quality metrics use finite ratio, dynamic range, clipping/dropout checks, and modality-specific sanity ranges as deterministic preprocessing gates before downstream tools.
entries.next_wrapper: Calibrate quality thresholds against labeled artifact/noise benchmarks per modality and report rejection curves.

entries.task: Image scale/OCR and waveform digitization support
existing_work: Digitization benchmark manifests cover rendered waveform images with known crop bounds, sampling rates, references, masks, and low/high-resolution variants; scale estimation combines OCR/axis evidence when available with priors only as fallback.
entries.next_wrapper: Separate OCR-scale success from waveform-recovery success and add low-resolution rejection/calibration curves.

entries.task: Generic spectrogram rendering and feature extraction
existing_work: Spectrogram tools use scipy STFT/spectrogram features for PCG/EMG/EEG/RESP-style time-frequency routing and visualization; used as inputs for downstream feature models and report artifacts.
entries.next_wrapper: Add benchmarked spectrogram parameter presets per modality and compare STFT/CWT/mel-style variants.

entries.task: SCG cardiac mechanics, fiducials, placement, and abnormality proxies
existing_work: SCG tools estimate fiducials, timing intervals, placement consistency, respiration, and mechanical abnormality proxies from local extrema/envelope/timing features; benchmark work includes VHD and CEBS-style SCG tasks but remains auxiliary to ECG when labels are limited.
entries.next_wrapper: Replace remaining SCG proxies with labeled multi-task benchmarks where ECG references and clinical labels are available.

existing_work: RESP event tools estimate rate, apnea, hypopnea, and event burden from airflow/respiration windows with event-level scoring planned against PSG/SpO2-aligned benchmarks.
entries.next_wrapper: Run standalone event-level apnea/hypopnea scoring and fuse RESP with SpO2 where available.

entries.task: EMG fatigue ML and activation/frequency benchmarks
existing_work: EMG fatigue tools combine activation and frequency-domain features with ML/proxy outputs; fatigue remains benchmark-dependent and should report dataset and muscle/task context.
entries.next_wrapper: Add subject-heldout fatigue benchmarks and calibration for task/muscle-specific fatigue thresholds.

existing_work: Full PTB-XL 12-lead ResNet binary superclass models trained on 21,388 records with fold-10 evaluation.
entries.next_wrapper: Validated 12-lead PTB-XL superclass backend. Use only when true 12-lead ECG is available; keep single-lead feature/rule tools as fallback.
